title: Fog Words
one_line_rule: Guess today's San Francisco word in six tries.

brief.intent: learn the city with your new Group

style.cover_prompt: hand-drawn ink and watercolor sketch of fog rolling over San Francisco rooftops, a few letters drifting in the mist, off-white paper, loose hatching

clues.FOGGY: How most summer mornings look out in the Sunset
clues.HILLS: The city has more than forty of them, and you will climb them all
clues.CABLE: The kind of car you can hang off on Powell Street
clues.BRIDGE: The famous one here is painted orange, not gold
clues.MISSION: Sunny neighborhood of murals, taquerias and Dolores Park
clues.SOURDOUGH: Tangy bread the city has baked since the Gold Rush
clues.OCEAN: The long, windy beach at the west end of the city
clues.BAYSIDE: Right on the water, like the Embarcadero walk
clues.TROLLEY: Vintage streetcars that run along the F line
clues.DOLORES: The park where Saturday's newcomers' picnic is
clues.SUNSET: Foggy neighborhood by the ocean, and the time to climb Bernal Hill
clues.PIER: Number 39 is the one with the sea lions
clues.CHINATOWN: The oldest one in North America starts at the Dragon Gate
clues.PRESIDIO: Old army post turned giant park near the bridge
clues.MURAL: Painted walls all over Balmy Alley
